{{Short description|None}} {{Use dmy dates|date=July 2026}} Post-amendment to the Tamil Nadu Entertainment Tax Act 1939 on 27 September 2011, gross jumped to 130 per cent of net for films with non-Tamil titles and U certificates as well.[http://www.stationeryprinting.tn.gov.in/extraordinary/2011/368-Ex-IV-2.pdf Entertainment tax doubled to 30% (from 15%) for non-Tamil titles and U certificates] Commercial Taxes Department disclosed {{INR}}85.81 crore in entertainment tax revenue for the year.[https://ctd.tn.gov.in/documents/10184/20741/ADMINISTRATIVE+REPORT+2017-2018/748773c3-2f25-4192-a416-268eb4931cd9?version=1.1 CTD reports {{INR}}85.81 crore ET collection in 2016–17] According to the FICCI-EY media and entertainment industry report, the Tamil film segment registered domestic net box office receipts of {{INR}}946 crore with 12.6 crore admissions.{{Cite web|url=http://www.ufomoviez.com/images/Articles/Mint%20-11th%20April%202018.pdf|title=Kollywood admissions total 12.6 crore in India in 2016}} {{Tamil films}} == Box office collection == The highest-grossing films released in 2016, by worldwide [[box office]] [[gross revenue]], are as follows. {| class="wikitable" |+ !Rank !Title !Production company !Distributor !Worldwide gross !Ref. |- |1 |''[[Kabali (film)|Kabali]]'' |[[Kalaipuli S. Or has it? – Firstpost|date=3 August 2016|access-date=7 August 2016}}
